1	import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Invariants
2	
3	/-!
4	# Access kernel: conforming statics declarations and their numbering
5	
6	`StaticsConf` is the conformance of a statics declaration to §47 and §49 with no order between
7	identifiers. `StaticsOK` (`Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Invariants`) asks parents and owning statics to
8	be earlier statics; by §49 (last paragraph) this ordering only represents well-formedness. Every
9	conforming declaration has a consistent renumbering satisfying `StaticsOK`
10	(`StaticsConf.exists_renumber`), and every declaration satisfying `StaticsOK` conforms
11	(`StaticsConf.of_staticsOK`).
12	-/
13	
14	namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access
15	
16	/-! ## Conformance (§40, §47, §49) -/
17	
18	/-- Structural parent of static `i` (§40): `none` for a root static or an index outside the
19	declaration. -/
20	def staticParent (statics : Statics) (i : Nat) : Option Nat := (statics[i]?).bind (·.1.1)
21	
22	/-- Owning static of static `i` (§40, §47): `none` for a static owned by frame 0 or an index
23	outside the declaration. -/
24	def staticOwner (statics : Statics) (i : Nat) : Option Nat := (statics[i]?).bind (·.1.2.1)
25	
26	/-- Conformance of a statics declaration to §47 and §49, with no order between identifiers
27	(§49, last paragraph). Owners are frame 0 or a static (§40, §47), parents and owning statics are
28	declared statics (§49.2, §49.3), composition links are acyclic (§49.2), no static is owned,
29	directly or transitively, by itself (§47), and every structural part has its parent's owner
30	(§49.2, §40).
31	
32	Acyclicity is the irreflexivity of the transitive closure `Relation.TransGen` of the one-step
33	link (`a`'s parent, resp. owning static, is `b`): `TransGen link i i` holds exactly when a
34	nonempty chain of links leads from `i` back to `i`, which is what §47 ("owned, directly or
35	transitively, by itself") and §49.2 (acyclic composition links) exclude. No bound on chain
36	length is involved. -/
37	structure StaticsConf (statics : Statics) : Prop where
38	  /-- §49.2: composition links are valid; every structural parent is a declared static. -/
39	  parent_lt : ∀ i p, staticParent statics i = some p → p < statics.length
40	  /-- §49.3, §47: owners are valid; every owning static is a declared static. -/
41	  owner_lt : ∀ i o, staticOwner statics i = some o → o < statics.length
42	  /-- §49.2: composition links are acyclic; no static is its own strict structural ancestor. -/
43	  parent_acyclic : ∀ i, ¬ Relation.TransGen (fun a b => staticParent statics a = some b) i i
44	  /-- §47: no static is owned, directly or transitively, by itself. -/
45	  owner_acyclic : ∀ i, ¬ Relation.TransGen (fun a b => staticOwner statics a = some b) i i
46	  /-- §49.2, §40: every structural part shares its parent's owner. -/
47	  part_owner : ∀ i p, staticParent statics i = some p →
48	    staticOwner statics i = staticOwner statics p
49	
50	/-! ## Renumbering (§49, last paragraph; §63.2) -/
51	
52	/-- A static's entry with its references, parent and owning static, mapped through `τ`; its
53	kind and initial state are kept (§49, last paragraph). -/
54	def mapRefs (τ : Nat → Nat) (e : (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat) × Bool) :
55	    (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat) × Bool :=
56	  ((e.1.1.map τ, e.1.2.1.map τ, e.1.2.2), e.2)
57	
58	/-- Renumbering of a declaration by `σ` (§49, last paragraph): new index `i` holds old static
59	`σ[i]`, its parent and owning static mapped through the inverse `σ.idxOf`. Meant for `σ` a
60	permutation of `List.range statics.length`. -/
61	def renumber (σ : List Nat) (statics : Statics) : Statics :=
62	  σ.map fun j => mapRefs σ.idxOf ((statics[j]?).getD ((none, none, 0), false))
63	
64	/-- Consistent renumbering (§49, last paragraph; §63.2): the new index `σ.idxOf x` of every old
65	static `x` holds `x` with its parent and owning static mapped through `σ.idxOf`, and its kind and
66	initial state; the parts of every place keep their relative order, which is their positional
67	field order (§63.2; `kids` orders the parts of a place by index). -/
68	structure ConsistentRenumbering (σ : List Nat) (statics : Statics) : Prop where
69	  /-- Parents to parents, owning statics to owning statics, same kind and initial state. -/
70	  entry : ∀ x < statics.length,
71	    (renumber σ statics)[σ.idxOf x]? = (statics[x]?).map (mapRefs σ.idxOf)
72	  /-- §63.2: the field order of every place is preserved. -/
73	  field_order : ∀ x y p, staticParent statics x = some p → staticParent statics y = some p →
74	    x < y → σ.idxOf x < σ.idxOf y
75	
76	/-! ## Proof support: chains of a partial link -/
77	
78	/-- Pigeonhole: a duplicate-free list of numbers below `n` has at most `n` elements. -/
79	private theorem nodup_length_le : ∀ (n : Nat) (l : List Nat), l.Nodup → (∀ a ∈ l, a < n) →
80	    l.length ≤ n
81	  | 0, [], _, _ => Nat.le_refl _
82	  | 0, a :: _, _, h => absurd (h a (List.mem_cons_self ..)) (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
83	  | n + 1, l, hd, h => by
84	    have := nodup_length_le n (l.erase n) (hd.erase n) fun a ha => by
85	      rw [hd.mem_erase_iff] at ha
86	      have := h a ha.2
87	      omega
88	    rw [List.length_erase] at this
89	    split at this <;> omega
90	
91	/-- `k` links `f` from `x`. -/
92	private def iter (f : Nat → Option Nat) : Nat → Nat → Option Nat
93	  | 0, x => some x
94	  | k + 1, x => (iter f k x).bind f
95	
96	private theorem iter_add (f : Nat → Option Nat) (x i : Nat) : ∀ d,
97	    iter f (i + d) x = (iter f i x).bind (iter f d)
98	  | 0 => by
99	    show iter f i x = _
100	    cases iter f i x <;> rfl
101	  | d + 1 => by
102	    show (iter f (i + d) x).bind f = _
103	    rw [iter_add f x i d, Option.bind_assoc]
104	    rfl
105	
106	private theorem transGen_of_iter {f : Nat → Option Nat} {x : Nat} : ∀ {k y : Nat},
107	    iter f (k + 1) x = some y → Relation.TransGen (fun a b => f a = some b) x y
108	  | 0, _, h => .single h
109	  | k + 1, _, h => by
110	    obtain ⟨c, hc, hcy⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.1 h
111	    exact .tail (transGen_of_iter hc) hcy
112	
113	/-- An acyclic partial link whose targets are below `n` has chains of fewer than `n` links from
114	any `x < n`. -/
115	private theorem iter_bound {f : Nat → Option Nat} {n : Nat}
116	    (hacyc : ∀ a, ¬ Relation.TransGen (fun a b => f a = some b) a a)
117	    (hlt : ∀ a b, f a = some b → b < n) {x : Nat} (hx : x < n) {k : Nat}
118	    (hk : (iter f k x).isSome) : k < n := by
119	  let g := fun i => (iter f i x).getD 0
120	  have hsome : ∀ i ≤ k, iter f i x = some (g i) := by
121	    intro i hi
122	    have := iter_add f x i (k - i)
123	    rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel' hi] at this
124	    cases hc : iter f i x with
125	    | none => rw [hc] at this; rw [this] at hk; simp at hk
126	    | some c => simp [g, hc]
127	  have hlt' : ∀ a ∈ (List.range (k + 1)).map g, a < n := by
128	    intro a ha
129	    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 ha
130	    have hi' := hsome i (by rw [List.mem_range] at hi; omega)
131	    cases i with
132	    | zero => simp only [iter, Option.some.injEq] at hi'; omega
133	    | succ j =>
134	      obtain ⟨c, -, hc⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.1 hi'
135	      exact hlt c _ hc
136	  have hnd : ((List.range (k + 1)).map g).Nodup := by
137	    unfold List.Nodup
138	    rw [List.pairwise_map]
139	    refine List.pairwise_lt_range.imp_of_mem fun {i j} hi hj hij heq => ?_
140	    rw [List.mem_range] at hi hj
141	    have hj' := iter_add f x i (j - i)
142	    rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel' (Nat.le_of_lt hij), hsome i (by omega), hsome j (by omega), heq,
143	      Option.bind_some] at hj'
144	    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ : ∃ d, j - i = d + 1 := ⟨j - i - 1, by omega⟩
145	    rw [hd] at hj'
146	    exact hacyc _ (transGen_of_iter hj'.symm)
147	  have := nodup_length_le n _ hnd hlt'
148	  simp only [List.length_map, List.length_range] at this
149	  omega
150	
151	/-- Length of the chain of links `f` from `x`, cut at `k` links. -/
152	private def chainLen (f : Nat → Option Nat) : Nat → Nat → Nat
153	  | 0, _ => 0
154	  | k + 1, x => match f x with
155	    | none => 0
156	    | some y => chainLen f k y + 1
157	
158	private theorem chainLen_some {f : Nat → Option Nat} {k x y : Nat} (h : f x = some y) :
159	    chainLen f (k + 1) x = chainLen f k y + 1 := by
160	  show (match f x with | none => 0 | some y => chainLen f k y + 1) = _
161	  rw [h]
162	
163	private theorem chainLen_congr {f : Nat → Option Nat} {x y : Nat} (h : f x = f y) :
164	    ∀ k, chainLen f k x = chainLen f k y
165	  | 0 => rfl
166	  | _ + 1 => by simp only [chainLen, h]
167	
168	private theorem iter_of_chainLen_ne {f : Nat → Option Nat} : ∀ {k z : Nat},
169	    chainLen f (k + 1) z ≠ chainLen f k z → (iter f (k + 1) z).isSome
170	  | 0, z, h => by
171	    cases hz : f z with
172	    | none => simp [chainLen, hz] at h
173	    | some y => simp [iter, hz]
174	  | k + 1, z, h => by
175	    cases hz : f z with
176	    | none => simp [chainLen, hz] at h
177	    | some y =>
178	      rw [chainLen_some hz, chainLen_some hz] at h
179	      have := iter_add f z 1 (k + 1)
180	      rw [Nat.add_comm 1] at this
181	      rw [this]
182	      simp only [iter, Option.bind_some, hz]
183	      exact iter_of_chainLen_ne (by omega)
184	
185	/-- Under an acyclic link with targets below `n`, the chain length cut at `n` grows by one along
186	each link. -/
187	private theorem chainLen_step {f : Nat → Option Nat} {n : Nat}
188	    (hacyc : ∀ a, ¬ Relation.TransGen (fun a b => f a = some b) a a)
189	    (hlt : ∀ a b, f a = some b → b < n) {x y : Nat} (h : f x = some y) :
190	    chainLen f n x = chainLen f n y + 1 := by
191	  have hy := hlt x y h
192	  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = m + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
193	  rw [chainLen_some h]
194	  refine congrArg (· + 1) (Classical.byContradiction fun hne => ?_)
195	  have := iter_bound hacyc hlt hy (iter_of_chainLen_ne (k := m) (fun e => hne e.symm))
196	  omega

198	/-! ## Proof support: the order of a conforming declaration -/
199	
200	/-- Ownership depth of a static. -/
201	private def odepth (statics : Statics) (x : Nat) : Nat :=
202	  chainLen (staticOwner statics) statics.length x
203	
204	/-- Structural depth of a static. -/
205	private def sdepth (statics : Statics) (x : Nat) : Nat :=
206	  chainLen (staticParent statics) statics.length x
207	
208	/-- Lexicographic order on (ownership depth, structural depth, index). -/
209	private def keyLe (statics : Statics) (a b : Nat) : Bool :=
210	  decide (odepth statics a < odepth statics b ∨ odepth statics a = odepth statics b ∧
211	    (sdepth statics a < sdepth statics b ∨ sdepth statics a = sdepth statics b ∧ a ≤ b))
212	
213	private theorem idxOf_lt_of_key {statics : Statics} {σ : List Nat}
214	    (hσ : σ.Perm (List.range statics.length)) (hs : σ.Pairwise (fun a b => keyLe statics a b))
215	    {x y : Nat} (hx : x < statics.length) (hy : y < statics.length)
216	    (hk : odepth statics x < odepth statics y ∨ odepth statics x = odepth statics y ∧
217	      (sdepth statics x < sdepth statics y ∨ sdepth statics x = sdepth statics y ∧ x < y)) :
218	    σ.idxOf x < σ.idxOf y := by
219	  have hix := List.idxOf_lt_length_of_mem (hσ.mem_iff.2 (List.mem_range.2 hx))
220	  have hiy := List.idxOf_lt_length_of_mem (hσ.mem_iff.2 (List.mem_range.2 hy))
221	  have gx := List.getElem_idxOf hix
222	  have gy := List.getElem_idxOf hiy
223	  rcases Nat.lt_trichotomy (σ.idxOf x) (σ.idxOf y) with h | h | h
224	  · exact h
225	  · have : x = y := by
226	      rw [← gx, ← gy]
227	      exact getElem_congr rfl h hix
228	    subst this
229	    omega
230	  · have := List.pairwise_iff_getElem.1 hs _ _ hiy hix h
231	    rw [gx, gy] at this
232	    simp only [keyLe, decide_eq_true_eq] at this
233	    omega
234	
235	private theorem lt_of_parent {statics : Statics} {x p : Nat}
236	    (h : staticParent statics x = some p) : x < statics.length := by
237	  unfold staticParent at h
238	  cases hx : statics[x]? with
239	  | none => rw [hx] at h; cases h
240	  | some _ => exact (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.1 hx).1
241	
242	private theorem lt_of_owner {statics : Statics} {x o : Nat}
243	    (h : staticOwner statics x = some o) : x < statics.length := by
244	  unfold staticOwner at h
245	  cases hx : statics[x]? with
246	  | none => rw [hx] at h; cases h
247	  | some _ => exact (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.1 hx).1
248	
249	private theorem shape_parent (statics : Statics) (i : Nat) :
250	    ((statics.map (·.1))[i]?).bind (·.1) = staticParent statics i := by
251	  simp only [List.getElem?_map, staticParent]
252	  cases statics[i]? <;> rfl
253	
254	private theorem shape_owner (statics : Statics) (i : Nat) :
255	    ((statics.map (·.1))[i]?).bind (·.2.1) = staticOwner statics i := by
256	  simp only [List.getElem?_map, staticOwner]
257	  cases statics[i]? <;> rfl
258	
259	private theorem renumber_get {σ : List Nat} {statics : Statics} {i : Nat} (hi : i < σ.length)
260	    (hx : σ[i] < statics.length) :
261	    (renumber σ statics)[i]? = some (mapRefs σ.idxOf statics[σ[i]]) := by
262	  simp [renumber, hi, hx]
263	
264	private theorem renumber_parent {σ : List Nat} {statics : Statics} {i : Nat} (hi : i < σ.length)
265	    (hx : σ[i] < statics.length) :
266	    staticParent (renumber σ statics) i = (staticParent statics σ[i]).map σ.idxOf := by
267	  rw [staticParent, renumber_get hi hx, staticParent, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hx]
268	  rfl
269	
270	private theorem renumber_owner {σ : List Nat} {statics : Statics} {i : Nat} (hi : i < σ.length)
271	    (hx : σ[i] < statics.length) :
272	    staticOwner (renumber σ statics) i = (staticOwner statics σ[i]).map σ.idxOf := by
273	  rw [staticOwner, renumber_get hi hx, staticOwner, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hx]
274	  rfl

276	/-! ## Existence of a conforming numbering -/
277	
278	/-- Owner decision of 2026-11-06 on `StaticsOK`, point (a) (§47, §49 and its last paragraph,
279	§63.2): every declaration conforming to §47 and §49 has a consistent renumbering, a permutation
280	of its identifiers preserving parents, owning statics, kinds, initial states and field order,
281	that satisfies `StaticsOK`. -/
282	theorem StaticsConf.exists_renumber {statics : Statics} (h : StaticsConf statics) :
283	    ∃ σ : List Nat, σ.Perm (List.range statics.length) ∧ ConsistentRenumbering σ statics ∧
284	      StaticsOK (renumber σ statics) := by
285	  let σ := (List.range statics.length).mergeSort (keyLe statics)
286	  have hσ : σ.Perm (List.range statics.length) := List.mergeSort_perm _ _
287	  have hs : σ.Pairwise (fun a b => keyLe statics a b) :=
288	    List.pairwise_mergeSort
289	      (fun a b c hab hbc => by simp only [keyLe, decide_eq_true_eq] at *; omega)
290	      (fun a b => by simp only [keyLe, Bool.or_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]; omega) _
291	  have hnd : σ.Nodup := hσ.nodup_iff.2 List.nodup_range
292	  have hown : ∀ x o, staticOwner statics x = some o → odepth statics x = odepth statics o + 1 :=
293	    fun _ _ hxo => chainLen_step h.owner_acyclic h.owner_lt hxo
294	  have hpar : ∀ x p, staticParent statics x = some p → sdepth statics x = sdepth statics p + 1 :=
295	    fun _ _ hxp => chainLen_step h.parent_acyclic h.parent_lt hxp
296	  have hpo : ∀ x p, staticParent statics x = some p → odepth statics x = odepth statics p :=
297	    fun x p hxp => chainLen_congr (h.part_owner x p hxp) _
298	  refine ⟨σ, hσ, ⟨fun x hx => ?_, fun x y p hx hy hxy => ?_⟩, ?_⟩
299	  · have hix := List.idxOf_lt_length_of_mem (hσ.mem_iff.2 (List.mem_range.2 hx))
300	    simp [renumber, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hix, List.getElem_idxOf hix,
301	      List.getElem?_eq_getElem hx]
302	  · have := hpar x p hx
303	    have := hpar y p hy
304	    have := hpo x p hx
305	    have := hpo y p hy
306	    exact idxOf_lt_of_key hσ hs (lt_of_parent hx) (lt_of_parent hy) (by omega)
307	  · unfold StaticsOK ShapeOK
308	    intro i hi
309	    simp only [List.length_map, renumber, List.mem_range] at hi
310	    have hxi : σ[i] < statics.length := List.mem_range.1 (hσ.mem_iff.1 (List.getElem_mem hi))
311	    have hii : σ.idxOf σ[i] = i :=
312	      (List.Nodup.getElem_inj hnd).1 (List.getElem_idxOf (List.idxOf_lt_length_of_mem
313	        (List.getElem_mem hi)))
314	    simp only [shape_parent, shape_owner, Nat.sub_zero, Nat.zero_add, renumber_parent hi hxi,
315	      renumber_owner hi hxi]
316	    constructor
317	    · cases hp : staticParent statics σ[i] with
318	      | none => trivial
319	      | some p =>
320	        have hpl := h.parent_lt _ _ hp
321	        have hip := List.idxOf_lt_length_of_mem (hσ.mem_iff.2 (List.mem_range.2 hpl))
322	        have hpσ : σ[σ.idxOf p] = p := List.getElem_idxOf hip
323	        refine ⟨Nat.zero_le _, ?_, ?_⟩
324	        · have := hpar _ _ hp
325	          have := hpo _ _ hp
326	          have := idxOf_lt_of_key hσ hs hpl hxi (by omega)
327	          show σ.idxOf p < i
328	          omega
329	        · show (staticOwner statics σ[i]).map σ.idxOf = staticOwner (renumber σ statics) (σ.idxOf p)
330	          rw [renumber_owner hip (by rw [hpσ]; exact hpl), hpσ, h.part_owner _ _ hp]
331	    · cases ho : staticOwner statics σ[i] with
332	      | none => trivial
333	      | some o =>
334	        have hol := h.owner_lt _ _ ho
335	        have := hown _ _ ho
336	        have := idxOf_lt_of_key hσ hs hol hxi (by omega)
337	        exact ⟨Nat.zero_le _, show σ.idxOf o < i by omega⟩

339	/-! ## `StaticsOK` declarations conform -/
340	
341	private theorem rank_of_transGen {R : Nat → Nat → Prop} (rank : Nat → Nat)
342	    (h : ∀ a b, R a b → rank b < rank a) {a b : Nat} (hab : Relation.TransGen R a b) :
343	    rank b < rank a := by
344	  induction hab with
345	  | single hr => exact h _ _ hr
346	  | tail _ hr ih => exact Nat.lt_trans (h _ _ hr) ih
347	
348	/-- `StaticsOK` (§47, §49) is a numbering of a conforming declaration: it implies
349	`StaticsConf`. -/
350	theorem StaticsConf.of_staticsOK {statics : Statics} (h : StaticsOK statics) :
351	    StaticsConf statics := by
352	  have hok : ∀ i, i < statics.length →
353	      OptP (staticParent statics i)
354	        (fun r => r < i ∧ staticOwner statics i = staticOwner statics r) True ∧
355	      OptP (staticOwner statics i) (fun o => o < i) True := by
356	    intro i hi
357	    have := h i (List.mem_range.2 (by simpa using hi))
358	    simp only [shape_parent, shape_owner, Nat.sub_zero, Nat.zero_add] at this
359	    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := this
360	    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
361	    · cases hp : staticParent statics i with
362	      | none => trivial
363	      | some r =>
364	        rw [hp] at h1
365	        obtain ⟨-, h3, h4⟩ := h1
366	        exact ⟨h3, h4⟩
367	    · cases ho : staticOwner statics i with
368	      | none => trivial
369	      | some o =>
370	        rw [ho] at h2
371	        exact h2.2
372	  have hpar : ∀ a b, staticParent statics a = some b → b < a := fun a b hab => by
373	    have := (hok a (lt_of_parent hab)).1
374	    rw [hab] at this
375	    exact this.1
376	  have hown : ∀ a b, staticOwner statics a = some b → b < a := fun a b hab => by
377	    have := (hok a (lt_of_owner hab)).2
378	    rw [hab] at this
379	    exact this
380	  exact {
381	    parent_lt := fun i p hp => Nat.lt_trans (hpar i p hp) (lt_of_parent hp)
382	    owner_lt := fun i o ho => Nat.lt_trans (hown i o ho) (lt_of_owner ho)
383	    parent_acyclic := fun _ hc => Nat.lt_irrefl _ (rank_of_transGen id hpar hc)
384	    owner_acyclic := fun _ hc => Nat.lt_irrefl _ (rank_of_transGen id hown hc)
385	    part_owner := fun i p hp => by
386	      have := (hok i (lt_of_parent hp)).1
387	      rw [hp] at this
388	      exact this.2 }

390	/-! ## Non-vacuity examples (§47, §49, §63.2) -/
391	
392	namespace StaticsExamples
393	
394	/-- Static 0 is a part of static 1, declared before it (§49, last paragraph). -/
395	def partFirst : Statics := [((some 1, none, 0), true), ((none, none, 1), false)]
396	
397	/-- `partFirst` is not numbered parent first. -/
398	example : ¬ StaticsOK partFirst := by decide
399	
400	private theorem partFirst_owner : ∀ i, staticOwner partFirst i = none
401	  | 0 | 1 | _ + 2 => rfl
402	
403	/-- `partFirst` conforms to §47 and §49. -/
404	example : StaticsConf partFirst where
405	  parent_lt i p hp := by
406	    rcases i with _ | _ | i <;> simp [staticParent, partFirst] at hp ⊢
407	    omega
408	  owner_lt i o ho := by rw [partFirst_owner] at ho; cases ho
409	  parent_acyclic _ hc := Nat.lt_irrefl _ (rank_of_transGen (fun a => if a = 1 then 0 else 1)
410	    (fun a b hab => by
411	      rcases a with _ | _ | a <;> simp [staticParent, partFirst] at hab
412	      subst hab; decide) hc)
413	  owner_acyclic _ hc := Nat.lt_irrefl _ (rank_of_transGen (fun _ => 0)
414	    (fun a b hab => by rw [partFirst_owner] at hab; cases hab) hc)
415	  part_owner i p _ := by rw [partFirst_owner, partFirst_owner]
416	
417	/-- Its renumbering by `[1, 0]` satisfies `StaticsOK`. -/
418	example : StaticsOK (renumber [1, 0] partFirst) := by decide
419	
420	/-- Two fields 0 and 1 of static 2, declared before it (§63.2). -/
421	def fieldsFirst : Statics :=
422	  [((some 2, none, 0), true), ((some 2, none, 1), false), ((none, none, 2), false)]
423	
424	/-- Swapping the fields gives a declaration satisfying `StaticsOK`, but not a consistent
425	renumbering: the field order clause is not vacuous (§63.2). -/
426	example : StaticsOK (renumber [2, 1, 0] fieldsFirst) ∧
427	    ¬ ConsistentRenumbering [2, 1, 0] fieldsFirst :=
428	  ⟨by decide, fun h => absurd (h.field_order 0 1 2 rfl rfl (by decide)) (by decide)⟩
429	
430	/-- An ownership cycle does not conform (§47). -/
431	example : ¬ StaticsConf [((none, some 1, 0), true), ((none, some 0, 0), true)] :=
432	  fun h => h.owner_acyclic 0 (.tail (.single rfl) rfl)
433	
434	end StaticsExamples

147	/-- A guarded kernel step (§58) on a library state: `ok` with the effect and the registry
148	unchanged when the preconditions hold, `reject` otherwise. -/
149	def kg (L : LState) (p : Prop) [Decidable p] (s : S3) : Outcome3 LState :=
150	  if p then .ok ⟨s, L.arenas⟩ else .reject
151	
152	/-- The computed outcome of operation `o` from `L` (§58, §60–§78). `issue` follows `IssueD`
153	(static checks, availability `fail`, `split`, `store`); `reset` follows `ResetD` (`derive`,
154	`release`, §78.3). -/
155	def lstep (L : LState) : Op → Outcome3 LState
156	  | .derive src r m => kg L (DerivePre L.kern src r m) (deriveEff L.kern src r m)
157	  | .split src rs => kg L (SplitPre k L.kern src rs) (splitEff L.kern src rs)
158	  | .release a => kg L (ReleasePre L.kern a) (releaseEff L.kern a)
159	  | .transfer src dst => kg L (TransferPre k L.kern src dst) (transferEff L.kern src dst)
160	  | .depend q x => kg L (DependPre L.kern q x) (dependEff L.kern q x)
161	  | .enter ps ls => kg L (EnterPre L.kern ps ls) (enterEff L.kern ps ls)
162	  | .exit => kg L (ExitPre k L.kern) (exitEff L.kern)
163	  | .read a ls => kg L (Read3Pre L.kern a ls) L.kern
164	  | .write a ls => kg L (Write3Pre L.kern a ls) (write3Eff L.kern ls)
165	  | .writeShared a ls => kg L (WriteSharedPre k L.kern a ls) (write3Eff L.kern ls)
166	  | .pin p => kg L (PinPre L.kern p) (pinEff L.kern p)
167	  | .unpin o => kg L (UnpinPre k L.kern o) (unpinEff L.kern o)
168	  | .endUse p => kg L (EndUsePre k L.kern p) (endUseEff L.kern p)
169	  | .free p auth => kg L (FreePre k L.kern p auth) (freeEff L.kern p)
170	  | .alloc pr ow ls =>
171	    if AllocStatic k L.kern pr ow ls then
172	      if k.Satisfiable pr ls L.kern then .ok ⟨allocEff L.kern ow ls, L.arenas⟩ else .fail
173	    else .reject
174	  | .store a p => kg L (StorePre L.kern a p) (storeEff L.kern a p)
175	  | .newArena st i =>
176	    if NewArenaPre L.kern L.arenas [] st i then .ok (newArenaEff L st i) else .reject
177	  | .issue i r d =>
178	    match L.arenas[i]? with
179	    | none => .reject
180	    | some E =>
181	      if IssueStatic L.kern E r d then
182	        if Avail E r then
183	          if SplitPre k L.kern E.internal [r] then
184	            if StorePre (splitEff L.kern E.internal [r]) L.kern.A.length d then
185	              .ok ⟨storeEff (splitEff L.kern E.internal [r]) L.kern.A.length d,
186	                L.arenas.set i (issueMeta L.kern E r)⟩
187	            else .reject
188	          else .reject
189	        else .fail
190	      else .reject
191	  | .reset i =>
192	    match L.arenas[i]? with
193	    | none => .reject
194	    | some E =>
195	      if DerivePre L.kern E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify then
196	        if ReleasePre (deriveEff L.kern E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify)
197	            L.kern.A.length then
198	          if ResetNoDeps L.kern E then
199	            .ok ⟨releaseEff (deriveEff L.kern E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify)
200	              L.kern.A.length, L.arenas.set i (resetMeta L.kern E)⟩
201	          else .reject
202	        else .reject
203	      else .reject
204	
205	/-- The state after `o` from `L` when it is `ok`; `L` otherwise (§58). -/
206	def next (L : LState) (o : Op) : LState :=
207	  match lstep k L o with
208	  | .ok L' => L'
209	  | _ => L
210	
211	/-- The state reached by the operations `os` from `L` when every step is `ok` (§58); `none` as soon
212	as a step is not `ok`. -/
213	def lrun (L : LState) : List Op → Option LState
214	  | [] => some L
215	  | o :: os =>
216	    match lstep k L o with
217	    | .ok L' => lrun L' os
218	    | _ => none
219	
220	/-- The state reached by `os` from `LState.init statics` (§47); `LState.init statics` when a step is
221	not `ok` (used only under `(lrun …).isSome = true`, see `runsTo`). -/
222	def final (statics : Statics) (os : List Op) : LState :=
223	  (lrun k (LState.init statics) os).getD (LState.init statics)
224	
225	/-- A run of `os` from `LState.init statics` (§47) has only `ok` steps and reaches `L`; `L` is
226	library-reachable (Part XIV) and its kernel state is reachable (§57). -/
227	structure RunsTo (statics : Statics) (os : List Op) (L : LState) : Prop where
228	  /-- Every step of the run is `ok` and the run ends in `L`. -/
229	  run : lrun k (LState.init statics) os = some L
230	  /-- `L` is library-reachable (Part XIV, §46). -/
231	  lreach : LReach k statics L
232	  /-- The kernel state of `L` is reachable from `S3.init statics` by O1–O16 (§57). -/
233	  reach : Reachable k statics L.kern
234	
235	/-- The run of `os` from `LState.init statics` has only `ok` steps (§47, §57, Part XIV). -/
236	abbrev Runs (statics : Statics) (os : List Op) : Prop :=
237	  RunsTo k statics os (final k statics os)
238	
239	end Exec
240	
241	/-! ## Soundness -/
242	
243	/-- An `ok` outcome of a relation of `OpRel` is a library step (Part XIV, §57): a kernel step
244	O1–O16 with the registry unchanged, `newArena`, the derived `issue` or the derived `reset`. -/
245	theorem opRel_ok {k : K} {L L' : LState} : ∀ {o : Op}, OpRel k L o (.ok L') → LStep k L L'
246	  | .derive .., h | .split .., h | .release .., h | .transfer .., h | .depend .., h
247	  | .enter .., h | .exit, h | .read .., h | .write .., h | .writeShared .., h | .pin .., h
248	  | .unpin .., h | .endUse .., h | .free .., h | .alloc .., h | .store .., h => by
249	    obtain ⟨h, e⟩ := h
250	    have hL : L' = ⟨L'.kern, L.arenas⟩ := by rw [← e]
251	    rw [hL]
252	    first
253	      | exact .kernel (.derive h) | exact .kernel (.split h) | exact .kernel (.release h)
254	      | exact .kernel (.transfer h) | exact .kernel (.depend h) | exact .kernel (.enter h)
255	      | exact .kernel (.exit h) | exact .kernel (.read h) | exact .kernel (.write h)
256	      | exact .kernel (.writeShared h) | exact .kernel (.pin h) | exact .kernel (.unpin h)
257	      | exact .kernel (.endUse h) | exact .kernel (.free h) | exact .kernel (.alloc h)
258	      | exact .kernel (.store h)
259	  | .newArena .., h => .newArena h
260	  | .issue .., h => .issue h
261	  | .reset .., h => .reset h
262	
263	section Sound
264	variable {k : K} [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
265	  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
266	  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]
267	
268	/-- A guarded kernel step computed by `kg` is an outcome of its relation (§58). -/
269	theorem kg_sound {L : LState} {p : Prop} [Decidable p] {s : S3} :
270	    KRel (Guarded p s) L.arenas (kg L p s) := by
271	  unfold kg
272	  split
273	  · next h => exact ⟨.ok h, rfl⟩
274	  · next h => exact .reject h
275	
276	/-- **Step soundness** (§58, §60–§78): the computed outcome of `o` from `L` is an outcome of the
277	relation of `o`, `ok`, `reject` and `fail` alike. -/
278	theorem lstep_sound (L : LState) (o : Op) : OpRel k L o (lstep k L o) := by
279	  cases o with
280	  | derive => exact kg_sound
281	  | split => exact kg_sound
282	  | release => exact kg_sound
283	  | transfer => exact kg_sound
284	  | depend => exact kg_sound
285	  | enter => exact kg_sound
286	  | exit => exact kg_sound
287	  | read => exact kg_sound
288	  | write => exact kg_sound
289	  | writeShared => exact kg_sound
290	  | pin => exact kg_sound
291	  | unpin => exact kg_sound
292	  | endUse => exact kg_sound
293	  | free => exact kg_sound
294	  | store => exact kg_sound
295	  | alloc pr ow ls =>
296	    show KRel (AllocStep k pr ow ls L.kern) L.arenas _
297	    dsimp only [lstep]
298	    split
299	    · next h =>
300	      split
301	      · next hs => exact ⟨.ok h hs, rfl⟩
302	      · next hs => exact .fail h hs
303	    · next h => exact .reject h
304	  | newArena st i =>
305	    show NewArenaStep [] st i L _
306	    dsimp only [lstep]
307	    split
308	    · next h => exact .ok h
309	    · next h => exact .reject h
310	  | issue i r d =>
311	    show IssueD k i r d L _
312	    dsimp only [lstep]
313	    split
314	    · next hE => exact .noEntry hE
315	    · next E hE =>
316	      split
317	      · next h1 =>
318	        split
319	        · next h2 =>
320	          split
321	          · next h3 =>
322	            split
323	            · next h4 => exact .ok hE h1 h2 (.ok h3) (.ok h4)
324	            · next h4 => exact .store hE h1 h2 (.ok h3) (.reject h4)
325	          · next h3 => exact .split hE h1 h2 (.reject h3)
326	        · next h2 => exact .fail hE h1 h2
327	      · next h1 => exact .static hE h1
328	  | reset i =>
329	    show ResetD i L _
330	    dsimp only [lstep]
331	    split
332	    · next hE => exact .noEntry hE
333	    · next E hE =>
334	      split
335	      · next h1 =>
336	        split
337	        · next h2 =>
338	          split
339	          · next h3 => exact .ok hE (.ok h1) (.ok h2) h3
340	          · next h3 => exact .contract hE (.ok h1) (.ok h2) h3
341	        · next h2 => exact .release hE (.ok h1) (.reject h2)
342	      · next h1 => exact .derive hE (.reject h1)
343	
344	/-- An `ok` computed step is a library step (Part XIV, §58). -/
345	theorem lstep_ok {L L' : LState} {o : Op} (h : lstep k L o = .ok L') : LStep k L L' :=
346	  opRel_ok (h ▸ lstep_sound L o)
347	
348	/-- A run whose steps are all `ok`, from a library-reachable state, ends in a library-reachable
349	state (Part XIV, §46). -/
350	theorem lrun_reach {statics : Statics} :
351	    ∀ {L L' : LState} {os : List Op}, LReach k statics L → lrun k L os = some L' →
352	      LReach k statics L'
353	  | _, _, [], hL, h => by cases h; exact hL
354	  | L, _, o :: os, hL, h => by
355	    unfold lrun at h
356	    cases hs : lstep k L o with
357	    | ok L₁ => rw [hs] at h; exact lrun_reach (.step hL (lstep_ok hs)) h
358	    | reject => rw [hs] at h; cases h
359	    | fail => rw [hs] at h; cases h
360	
361	/-- **Run soundness** (§47, §57, Part XIV): when every step of `os` from `LState.init statics` is
362	`ok`, the run reaches `final k statics os`, which is library-reachable and whose kernel state is
363	reachable by O1–O16. -/
364	theorem runsTo {statics : Statics} {os : List Op}
365	    (h : (lrun k (LState.init statics) os).isSome = true) : Runs k statics os := by
366	  have hr : lrun k (LState.init statics) os = some (final k statics os) := by
367	    unfold final
368	    cases e : lrun k (LState.init statics) os with
369	    | none => rw [e] at h; cases h
370	    | some L => rfl
371	  have hl := lrun_reach .init hr
372	  exact ⟨hr, hl, hl.ng.reachable⟩
373	
374	/-- A computed `reject` is a `reject` outcome of the relation (§58). -/
375	theorem rejects {L : LState} {o : Op} (h : verdictOf (lstep k L o) = .reject) :
376	    OpRel k L o .reject := by
377	  have hs := lstep_sound (k := k) L o
378	  revert hs h
379	  cases lstep k L o with
380	  | ok => intro h; cases h
381	  | reject => intro _ hs; exact hs
382	  | fail => intro h; cases h
383	
384	/-- A computed `fail` is a `fail` outcome of the relation (§58). -/
385	theorem fails {L : LState} {o : Op} (h : verdictOf (lstep k L o) = .fail) :
386	    OpRel k L o .fail := by
387	  have hs := lstep_sound (k := k) L o
388	  revert hs h
389	  cases lstep k L o with
390	  | ok => intro h; cases h
391	  | reject => intro h; cases h
392	  | fail => intro _ hs; exact hs
393	
394	/-- A computed `ok` is the `ok` outcome of the relation to `next k L o` (§58). -/
395	theorem oks {L : LState} {o : Op} (h : verdictOf (lstep k L o) = .ok) :
396	    OpRel k L o (.ok (next k L o)) := by
397	  have hs := lstep_sound (k := k) L o
398	  unfold next
399	  revert hs h
400	  cases lstep k L o with
401	  | ok => intro _ hs; exact hs
402	  | reject => intro h; cases h
403	  | fail => intro h; cases h
404	
405	end Sound
406	
407	end Ern.Corpus

content.content:
## 40. Logical Places, Leaves, and Ownership

A place has an identity, optionally a structural parent, an abstract `kind`, an owner `owner : Frame | Place`, and a logical death marker. Structural parenthood `partOf(p,q)` describes the subplaces of a value; `owner` describes **who keeps the storage** of a root place valid. An owned place may lie outside its owner's direct footprint; ownership and composition are therefore distinct.

A **leaf** is a place with no structural children. `footprint(p)` contains the leaves of `p`, and access rights over a place are evaluated on those leaves. Places transitively owned by a value are not automatically leaves of its `footprint`. A logical unit of the access discipline does not automatically constitute an additional allocation in the elementary memory machine.

A place `p` is **usable** (`Usable(s,p)`) if and only if:

1. `p` exists and is not marked dead;
2. if its owner is a frame, that frame belongs to the stack;
3. if its owner is a place `q`, then `q` is itself usable and the chain terminates at a frame in the stack.

An ownership cycle makes no place usable. `placeFrame(p)` is the terminal frame of this chain when `p` is usable. Structural parts share their parent's owner and death marker. A value may be logically ended by `endUse` without the place that contained it becoming unusable; the substorages it owned may, however, die.

A **root place** has no structural parent. Every **usable** root place has a root authority of own mode `Modify`, with no origin, held exactly by that place's owner (`RootHeld`). This authority cannot be transferred in isolation; root ownership follows a legal transfer of the owning value when necessary.
## 42. Authorities, Modes, Holders, and Origins

An authority conceptually has the following fields:

```text
Authority {
    id
    mode: Observe | Modify
    origin?: AuthorityId
    footprint: Set<Leaf>
    holder: Frame | Place
    active: Bool
}
```

`origin` links a derived authority to its current origin. Authorities have fresh identities and well-formed origin chains. A root authority has no origin; a derived authority has one. Creating derived rights does not increase the scope or permitted mode of the origin.

The **holder** (`holder`) is not the **owner** (`owner`). An authority derived by `derive` or `split` is initially held by the current frame; `store` or a permitted transfer may make it held by a place. The derived `issue` operation proceeds through `split` followed by `store`. `release` does not release a root. There is no persistent `Suspended` field: suspension of rights is inferred from active descendants and applies leaf by leaf.

## 44. Dependencies and Effective Anchors

`D(p)` is the set of authorities serving as **validity anchors** for place `p`. An anchor is valid as long as the authority it names is active. Dependencies of contained values are accounted for transitively. Relevant dependencies follow the value during transfer; those of its container do not automatically follow a part transferred in isolation.

For an authority `x`, its **effective anchor** is the root reached by traversing its origin chain. It does not necessarily coincide with its current holder. Lifetime constraints are calculated from the frame of that effective anchor and the frames of places that remain usable. A dependency cannot create a right or artificially extend a lifetime.

`AnchorOrder` requires, for every anchor `x ∈ D(q)` of a usable place `q`, that the frame of the effective anchor of `x` be the frame of `q` or one of its ancestors. `AnchorOrderHeld` imposes the same rule on every **active authority held** by `q`. These conditions apply to the resulting states of operations that move or create holder relations.

## 47. Initial State

The kernel's initial state contains only base frame 0 and the declared static storage. Every static leaf has its declared initial state, `Init` or `Uninit`. The roots of static places directly owned by frame 0 have a root `Modify` authority held by that frame; a static may also be owned by another static, in which case its root authority is held by the latter. The ownership graph of statics is acyclic: no static is owned, directly or transitively, by itself. The initial state invents no dynamic allocation, derived authority, or implicit anchor. The initial arena registry belongs to library state and is empty. The initial frame does not exit.

## 48. External Parametric Contract

`K` contains the predicates `DeclaredDisjoint`, `SharedMutable`, `Pinned`, `ExternalDone`, `Deallocable`, `FreeCompat`, and `Satisfiable`. Their obligations are specified in Section 80. `K` can neither fabricate access rights nor remove an obligation of the Charter. The predicate `Invalidates` is not part of this contract.

# VII. Invariants of Reachable States

Machine states are subject to structural, validity, and exclusivity requirements preserved by permitted transitions under their declared external contracts.

## 49. WF3 — Well-Formedness of Frames, Places, and Authorities

`WF3(s)` is a **predicate on state `s`**. It jointly requires:

1. a nonempty, duplicate-free frame stack, every frame having a valid identity and, except for the base frame, a valid parent; frame-parent relations are well-founded;
2. a place structure whose composition links are valid and **acyclic**; every structural part shares its parent's owner and death marker;
3. valid owners of type frame or place, and **well-founded** ownership chains reaching a live frame for every usable place;
4. footprints consisting exclusively of leaves of existing places;
5. authorities with valid identities and modes, whose existing origins form **acyclic** chains ending at a root authority;
6. `RootChain`: every origin chain of an authority covering a leaf ends at the root of the **same structural root place** as that leaf;
7. `RootHeld`: every usable root place has its active root `Modify` authority, with no origin, held exactly by its owner;
8. holder validity: every active authority is held by a frame present in the stack or by a usable place.

Numerical ordering of identifiers, parent precedence over child in a list, and bounds on generated identifiers may be used **to represent or prove** this well-formedness in a formalization; they are not normative restrictions on place or authority identities. Preservation of `WF3` by a transition is a **required property of transitions**, not an additional clause of the state predicate. `WF3` does not impose any particular physical object layout: that belongs to refinement into the elementary memory machine.

## 50. I1 — Structural Exclusivity

For two active authorities **unrelated by derivation** covering the same leaf, their own modes must both be `Observe`. This rule also applies to leaves identified as `SharedMutable`; their particular mutation is governed by the `writeShared` contract and creates no exception to I1.

## 63. O4 — Consuming Value Transfer

**Preconditions**

1. `source` and `destination` are usable, and the current frame has exercisable `Modify` over their relevant footprints.
2. Source and destination have the **same shape of ordered subtrees**. The `i`-th child of each source part corresponds to the `i`-th child of the corresponding destination part; all nodes are matched. Structural field identity is positional, not an arbitrary matching of children.
3. **All** source leaves are `Init`, and **no** destination leaf is `Init`. The source and destination footprints are disjoint.
4. No exclusive authority is duplicated; validity of derived authorities and active projections is preserved. No active derived authority held outside `source` covers a source leaf, except the authorities through which the step exercises its `Modify` right over `source`: the exercisable authority on which that right rests and its origin chain. Other active authorities remain subject to this check. Authorities held by parts of `source` are transferred with the value and are controlled by §63.8.
5. **No in-place source leaf is pinned**, either statically (`K.Pinned`) or dynamically (`pin`). Storage merely **owned** by the source, which is not itself moved by the transfer of that value, does not prevent this transfer.
6. Dependencies of all still-usable places following the value remain valid; non-escape constraints and `AnchorOrder` are checked in the **resulting state**, including transferred anchors of owned places that remain usable.
7. All moved held authorities, including those of owned storage, satisfy `AnchorOrderHeld` in the resulting state; no authority may escape a local anchor on the grounds that its containing value was transferred.
8. **Local self-blocking prevention:** For each active authority held before the step by a part `r` of `source` whose holder becomes the corresponding part `corr(r)` of `destination`, that authority's footprint contains **no leaf** of `corr(r)` in the resulting state. Transfer is rejected if this local check fails; no global authority-acyclicity check is imposed.
9. **Destination usability:** `destination` is usable in the resulting state.

**`ok` effect:**

- every source leaf becomes `Moved` and each corresponding destination leaf becomes `Init`;
- every authority held by source part `r` acquires as its new holder the corresponding destination part `corr(r)`, not indiscriminately the destination root;
- places owned by `r` become owned by `corr(r)`; their roots follow this owner according to `RootHeld`;
- value dependencies follow the corresponding places under validity guarantees; no authority is created or duplicated;
- destination places receive the transferred values and rights without automatically moving storage not owned by a source part.

**Other outcome:** `reject`. `transfer` to a call result is subject to these same rules.

A partially initialized structure may be transferred **field by field**, but only for fields individually eligible for transfer. This does not automatically destructure a value that owns storage **at the container level**: that storage stays with the container if the container is not transferred. Conversion between structures with permuted fields must be handled separately, not as a `transfer`.

## 70. O13 — Release of an Owned Storage Unit

**Preconditions**

1. `place` is a **root of storage owned by a value** (`OwnedRoot`), not an ordinary local directly owned by a frame and not part of an aggregate.
2. `K.Deallocable(place)` is established, and `K.FreeCompat(place,auth)` justifies deallocation authority `auth`; this identifier is opaque to the authority kernel.
3. The current frame has exercisable `Modify`; no active derivative over the footprint being freed is held outside holders that die; no surviving place is anchored to an authority of the released region or of its dead holders. The authorities through which the step exercises its `Modify` right over `place`, namely the exercisable authority on which that right rests and its origin chain, are exempt from the check on active derivatives. Moreover, no authority that the effect makes inactive (an authority of the released region, its root included, or an authority whose holder dies) has an active descendant, whatever its footprint, that the same step does not make inactive.
4. No leaf of the released unit is statically or dynamically pinned. Ending external use does not silently turn a still-pinned leaf into a releasable unit.

**`ok` effect:** `place` and the storage that ceases to live are marked dead; authorities of those regions, including their corresponding roots, become inactive, as do authorities whose holders die. Surviving dependencies must remain valid. Every realization of `free` must satisfy the corresponding deallocation relation of the elementary memory machine (Part III). **Other outcome:** `reject`.

## 71. O14 — Allocation of a New Storage Root

**Static preconditions**

1. `shape` is a **nonempty** abstract shape, represented like the local places of `enterFrame`; an allocation of **zero physical size** may be represented by a logical one-leaf shape.
2. The provider is a usable place, and **all leaves of the provider** are `Init`; updates to its metadata are permitted through exercisable `Modify` or a valid `writeShared` over `SharedMutable` metadata.
3. The current frame has exercisable `Modify` over `owner`; new identities and ownership relations must respect `WF3`, `RootHeld`, and liveness restrictions.

**Outcomes**

- `reject`: a static precondition does not hold;
- `fail`: static preconditions hold, but `K.Satisfiable(provider,shape,s)` is false in the state under consideration; **no state change**;
- `ok(s')`: creation of a **new storage root** with fresh identity, owned by `owner`; its leaves start `Uninit`, its new root `Modify` authority with no origin is held by `owner`; provider metadata is updated only in accordance with its modification rights.

Allocation success depends on the provider's state: it does not constitute a right to invent physical memory. Any realization of this operation must satisfy the `AllocStep` relation defined by the rules of Sections 9 and 13.

# XII. Call Frames and Return of Authorities

Frames are execution units that receive authorities, introduce locals, and have exit rules distinct from Spec 3's value-passing conventions.

## 72. O6 — Entering a Frame
## 74. O15 — Dynamic Pinning

**Preconditions:** `place` is usable, the current frame has exercisable `Modify` over the relevant leaves, and the operation respects applicable pinning obligations.

**`ok` effect:** A dynamic pinning obligation of fresh identity is installed on the relevant leaves. A leaf is dynamically pinned while at least one active pinning obligation covers it. While an obligation is active, `transfer`, `endUse`, `free`, and `exitFrame` are rejected if they act on leaves it pins; removal of this obligation requires `unpin` under `K.ExternalDone`. Pinning does not make contents immutable. **Other outcome:** `reject`.

## 75. O16 — Removal of Dynamic Pinning

**Preconditions:** `unpin` designates one active dynamic pinning obligation, installed by `pin` on `place`; `place` is usable, the current frame has exercisable `Modify`, and contract `K.ExternalDone`, applied to that obligation, attests that all relevant external use has ended.

**`ok` effect:** The designated dynamic pinning obligation ends, and only that one: a leaf it covered stays pinned while another active obligation covers it. The step does not itself modify values, their initialization, or their access authorities. Static obligations are not removed by this operation. **Other outcome:** `reject`.

**Associated static rule (`StaticPinnedBottom`):** Statics designated by `K.Pinned` must be places **directly** owned by the **base frame**, not merely transitively owned by a static value. This restriction ensures that they do not die when an intermediate frame exits.

# XIV. Arenas and Collective Invalidation — Reference Abstraction

An arena is a **library abstraction**, not a memory-kernel primitive. Operations O17 through O19 are **derived** from operations O1 through O16 and abstraction-specific metadata: `newArena` registers an administration without modifying the kernel; `issue` performs `split` followed by `store` (after checking availability); `reset` performs a `Modify` derivation over all storage—through `derive` or `split`—then `release`, before restoring availability. Their contract below is **normative for the standard-library arena** until Spec 10 takes responsibility for it. It authorizes neither new permissions nor an additional access machine. Arena entries (Section 46) constitute the abstract state of this administration; the guard in Section 56 belongs to its consistency contract. The contracts of `HandlePool` and `DataStack` belong to their library abstractions and are not defined here.

import Ern.MemoryModel.Machine

/-!
# Corpus MM2-H on the memory machine (test module, spec v0.1 Parts II–III, §8–§20)

Test module. It states no semantics: it runs the MM2-H corpus (non-normative validation
material, 17 identifiers, H13 split into H13a and H13b, 18 scenarios) on the relations of
`Ern.MemoryModel.Machine`.

Each case gives a state reached from the empty state, an admissible initial state (§9 ¶9), by an
execution of `ok` steps (`Exec`, §20.3 ¶3), and the outcome of the normative relation at that
state (`ReadStep`, `WriteStep`, `DeallocStep`, `AllocStep`, §20.1), proved by `decide` or by the
machine lemmas. Each `ub` case has a separate `_twin` theorem for the corpus's positive twin.
The docstring of each theorem states the expected verdict from the corpus, the obtained verdict,
and the class (rule "classement" of the corpus: `N2` = memory machine). Where the obtained
verdict differs from the expected one, the docstring says "Mismatch" and the case is kept as
written, not corrected.

Context of every execution (§20.3 ¶1, §20.3 ¶3: explicit context parameters): compatibility is
equality of the presented authority with the recorded token (§17 ¶4); read and write
obligations are the machine's explicit test instances `Witness.obR` and `Witness.obW` (both parts
`True`), except in H14, which needs a false static part.

Open boundaries of the spec, classified non-blocking and not declared passed: H10 address
formation (§14 ¶4, §19), H13a at language level (§10 ¶4, §19), H13b (§19).
-/

namespace Ern.Corpus.MM2H

open Ern.MemoryModel.Machine

/-! ## Run builders -/

section Builders

variable {Ty : Type} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {R : ReadOblSpec Ty} {W : WriteOblSpec Ty}

/-- An execution extended by one `ok` step at its end is an execution (§20.1 ¶2, §20.3 ¶3). -/
theorem exec_snoc {ops : List (Op Ty)} {op : Op Ty} {s₀ s s' : State}
    (h : Exec C R W ops s₀ s) (hs : Step C R W op s s') : Exec C R W (ops ++ [op]) s₀ s' := by
  induction h with
  | nil => exact .cons hs (.nil _)
  | cons h₀ _ ih => exact .cons h₀ (ih hs)

/-- Appending an `ok` raw creation to an execution from the empty state. The decidable form
`AllocPreDec` suffices because every reached state satisfies freshness (§9 ¶7, §9 ¶9, §9 ¶11). -/
theorem run_alloc {ops : List (Op Ty)} {s : State} {space base size align : Nat}
    {freeAuth : Option Nat} (h : Exec C R W ops State.empty s)
    (hp : AllocPreDec s space base size align) :
    Exec C R W (ops ++ [.alloc space base size align freeAuth]) State.empty
      (s.alloc space base size align freeAuth) :=
  exec_snoc h (.alloc (.ok ((allocPreDec_iff (h.admissible admissible_empty).wf).1 hp)))

/-- Appending an `ok` raw write to an execution from the empty state (§16, §20.2 ¶2). -/
theorem run_write {ops : List (Op Ty)} {s : State} {ac : Access} {t : Ty}
    {w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat} (h : Exec C R W ops State.empty s) (hc : CanWrite s ac)
    (hd : W.dec s ac t w) (hs : W.stat s ac t w) :
    Exec C R W (ops ++ [.write ac t w]) State.empty (s.write ac w) :=
  exec_snoc h (.write (.ok ⟨hc, hd, hs⟩))

/-- Appending an `ok` raw deallocation to an execution from the empty state (§17, §20.2 ¶2). -/
theorem run_dealloc {ops : List (Op Ty)} {s : State} {id auth : Nat}
    (h : Exec C R W ops State.empty s) (hc : CanDealloc C s id auth) :
    Exec C R W (ops ++ [.dealloc id auth]) State.empty (s.dealloc id) :=
  exec_snoc h (.dealloc (.ok hc))

/-- Appending an `ok` raw read to an execution from the empty state; the state is unchanged
(§15, §20.2 ¶1). -/
theorem run_read {ops : List (Op Ty)} {s : State} {ac : Access} {t : Ty} {v : List AByte}
    (h : Exec C R W ops State.empty s) (hr : ReadStep R ac t s (.ok v)) :
    Exec C R W (ops ++ [.read ac t]) State.empty s :=
  exec_snoc h (.read hr)

/-- At a state reached from the empty state, a creation whose decidable preconditions fail is
`ub` (§9 ¶11, §20.1 ¶2). -/
theorem allocStep_ub {ops : List (Op Ty)} {s : State} {space base size align : Nat}
    {freeAuth : Option Nat} (h : Exec C R W ops State.empty s)
    (hn : ¬ AllocPreDec s space base size align) :
    AllocStep space base size align freeAuth s .ub :=
  .ub (mt (allocPreDec_iff (h.admissible admissible_empty).wf).2 hn)

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Invariants

/-! Scratch: adversarial test of the renaming bisimulation (StaticsOK point (b)). -/

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

namespace RH

/-! ## Test contract given by lists, with declared disjointness and a state-reading Satisfiable -/

structure KD where
  shared : List Nat := []
  pinned : List Nat := []
  done : List Nat := []
  dealloc : List Nat := []
  compat : List (Nat × Nat) := []
  dd : List (List Nat × List Nat) := []
  satBan : List Nat := []
  satBound : Nat := 1000

def KD.toK (d : KD) : K :=
  ⟨fun r r' => (r, r') ∈ d.dd, (· ∈ d.shared), (· ∈ d.pinned), (· ∈ d.done), (· ∈ d.dealloc),
    fun p a => (p, a) ∈ d.compat, fun p ls s => p ∉ d.satBan ∧ s.P.length + ls.length ≤ d.satBound⟩

instance (d : KD) : ∀ r r', Decidable (d.toK.DeclaredDisjoint r r') :=
  fun r r' => inferInstanceAs (Decidable ((r, r') ∈ d.dd))
instance (d : KD) : DecidablePred d.toK.SharedMutable :=
  fun l => inferInstanceAs (Decidable (l ∈ d.shared))
instance (d : KD) : DecidablePred d.toK.Pinned :=
  fun l => inferInstanceAs (Decidable (l ∈ d.pinned))
instance (d : KD) : DecidablePred d.toK.ExternalDone :=
  fun p => inferInstanceAs (Decidable (p ∈ d.done))
instance (d : KD) : DecidablePred d.toK.Deallocable :=
  fun p => inferInstanceAs (Decidable (p ∈ d.dealloc))
instance (d : KD) : ∀ p a, Decidable (d.toK.FreeCompat p a) :=
  fun p a => inferInstanceAs (Decidable ((p, a) ∈ d.compat))
instance (d : KD) : ∀ p ls s, Decidable (d.toK.Satisfiable p ls s) :=
  fun p ls s => inferInstanceAs (Decidable (p ∉ d.satBan ∧ s.P.length + ls.length ≤ d.satBound))

/-! ## Operations and a computable step -/

inductive Op where
  | derive (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode)
  | split (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat))
  | release (a : Nat)
  | transfer (src dst : Nat)
  | depend (q x : Nat)
  | enter (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
  | exit
  | read (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
  | write (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
  | writeShared (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
  | pin (p : Nat)
  | unpin (o : Nat)
  | endUse (p : Nat)
  | free (p auth : Nat)
  | alloc (provider owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
  | store (a p : Nat)
deriving Repr

def Op.tag : Op → Nat
  | .derive .. => 0 | .split .. => 1 | .release .. => 2 | .transfer .. => 3 | .depend .. => 4
  | .enter .. => 5 | .exit => 6 | .read .. => 7 | .write .. => 8 | .writeShared .. => 9
  | .pin .. => 10 | .unpin .. => 11 | .endUse .. => 12 | .free .. => 13 | .alloc .. => 14
  | .store .. => 15

def tagName : List String := ["derive", "split", "release", "transfer", "depend", "enter",
  "exit", "read", "write", "writeShared", "pin", "unpin", "endUse", "free", "alloc", "store"]

inductive V | ok | reject | fail deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def g (p : Prop) [Decidable p] (s' s : S3) : V × S3 := if p then (.ok, s') else (.reject, s)

def step (d : KD) (s : S3) : Op → V × S3
  | .derive src r m => g (DerivePre s src r m) (deriveEff s src r m) s
  | .split src rs => g (SplitPre d.toK s src rs) (splitEff s src rs) s
  | .release a => g (ReleasePre s a) (releaseEff s a) s
  | .transfer a b => g (TransferPre d.toK s a b) (transferEff s a b) s
  | .depend q x => g (DependPre s q x) (dependEff s q x) s
  | .enter ps ls => g (EnterPre s ps ls) (enterEff s ps ls) s
  | .exit => g (ExitPre d.toK s) (exitEff s) s
  | .read a ls => g (Read3Pre s a ls) s s
  | .write a ls => g (Write3Pre s a ls) (write3Eff s ls) s
  | .writeShared a ls => g (WriteSharedPre d.toK s a ls) (write3Eff s ls) s
  | .pin p => g (PinPre s p) (pinEff s p) s
  | .unpin o => g (UnpinPre d.toK s o) (unpinEff s o) s
  | .endUse p => g (EndUsePre d.toK s p) (endUseEff s p) s
  | .free p a => g (FreePre d.toK s p a) (freeEff s p) s
  | .alloc pr ow ls =>
    if AllocStatic d.toK s pr ow ls then
      if d.toK.Satisfiable pr ls s then (.ok, allocEff s ow ls) else (.fail, s)
    else (.reject, s)
  | .store a p => g (StorePre s a p) (storeEff s a p) s

/-! ## Renaming -/

/-- A renaming: `sig` = new index of each old static (a permutation of `range n`); `al` = new
index of each old root authority. Identity beyond. -/
structure Ren where
  sig : List Nat
  al : List Nat

def Ren.pi (R : Ren) (i : Nat) : Nat := (R.sig[i]?).getD i
def Ren.piInv (R : Ren) (j : Nat) : Nat := if j < R.sig.length then R.sig.idxOf j else j
def Ren.alpha (R : Ren) (i : Nat) : Nat := (R.al[i]?).getD i
def Ren.alphaInv (R : Ren) (j : Nat) : Nat := if j < R.al.length then R.al.idxOf j else j

def Ren.holder (R : Ren) : Holder → Holder
  | .frame f => .frame f
  | .place p => .place (R.pi p)

def Ren.place (R : Ren) (pl : Place) : Place :=
  { pl with parent := pl.parent.map R.pi, owner := R.holder pl.owner }

def Ren.auth (R : Ren) (y : Authority) : Authority :=
  { y with origin := y.origin.map R.alpha, footprint := y.footprint.map R.pi,
           holder := R.holder y.holder }

def dPl : Place := ⟨none, .frame 0, 0⟩
def dAu : Authority := ⟨.observe, none, [], .frame 0, false⟩

/-- `ρ`: the exact state map. -/
def Ren.rho (R : Ren) (s : S3) : S3 :=
  { F := s.F, nF := s.nF
    P := (List.range s.P.length).map fun j => R.place ((s.P[R.piInv j]?).getD dPl)
    I := fun l => s.I (R.piInv l)
    A := (List.range s.A.length).map fun j => R.auth ((s.A[R.alphaInv j]?).getD dAu)
    D := fun q => (s.D (R.piInv q)).map R.alpha
    dead := fun q => s.dead (R.piInv q)
    pins := s.pins.map fun o => { o with place := R.pi o.place, leaves := o.leaves.map R.pi } }

def Ren.op (R : Ren) : Op → Op
  | .derive src r m => .derive (R.alpha src) (r.map R.pi) m
  | .split src rs => .split (R.alpha src) (rs.map (·.map R.pi))
  | .release a => .release (R.alpha a)
  | .transfer a b => .transfer (R.pi a) (R.pi b)
  | .depend q x => .depend (R.pi q) (R.alpha x)
  | .enter ps ls => .enter (ps.map R.alpha) ls
  | .exit => .exit
  | .read a ls => .read (R.alpha a) (ls.map R.pi)
  | .write a ls => .write (R.alpha a) (ls.map R.pi)
  | .writeShared a ls => .writeShared (R.alpha a) (ls.map R.pi)
  | .pin p => .pin (R.pi p)
  | .unpin o => .unpin o
  | .endUse p => .endUse (R.pi p)
  | .free p a => .free (R.pi p) a
  | .alloc pr ow ls => .alloc (R.pi pr) (R.pi ow) ls
  | .store a p => .store (R.alpha a) (R.pi p)

def Ren.kd (R : Ren) (d : KD) : KD :=
  { shared := d.shared.map R.pi, pinned := d.pinned.map R.pi, done := d.done
    dealloc := d.dealloc.map R.pi, compat := d.compat.map fun (p, a) => (R.pi p, a)
    dd := d.dd.map fun (r, r') => (r.map R.pi, r'.map R.pi)
    satBan := d.satBan.map R.pi, satBound := d.satBound }

/-! ## Equivalence up to permutation of footprints, anchors, pin leaves -/

def srt (l : List Nat) : List Nat := l.mergeSort (fun a b => decide (a ≤ b))

def eqAuth (x y : Authority) : Bool :=
  x.mode == y.mode && x.origin == y.origin && srt x.footprint == srt y.footprint &&
    x.holder == y.holder && x.active == y.active

def eqPin (x y : PinOb) : Bool :=
  x.place == y.place && srt x.leaves == srt y.leaves && x.active == y.active

def eqv (s t : S3) : Bool :=
  let b := max s.P.length t.P.length + 6
  s.F == t.F && s.nF == t.nF && s.P == t.P &&
  s.A.length == t.A.length && (List.zip s.A t.A).all (fun (x, y) => eqAuth x y) &&
  s.pins.length == t.pins.length && (List.zip s.pins t.pins).all (fun (x, y) => eqPin x y) &&
  (List.range b).all fun l => s.I l == t.I l && srt (s.D l) == srt (t.D l) && s.dead l == t.dead l

/-- Literal equality (lists compared positionally). -/
def eqLit (s t : S3) : Bool :=
  let b := max s.P.length t.P.length + 6
  s.F == t.F && s.nF == t.nF && s.P == t.P && s.A == t.A && s.pins == t.pins &&
  (List.range b).all fun l => s.I l == t.I l && s.D l == t.D l && s.dead l == t.dead l

/-! ## Candidate operations at a state (world A) -/

def leavesOf (s : S3) : List Nat := (List.range s.P.length).filter fun l => decide (isLeaf s.P l)

def regionsOf (s : S3) : List (List Nat) :=
  (leavesOf s).map (fun l => [l]) ++ ((List.range s.P.length).filter fun q => decide (¬ isLeaf s.P q)).map (footprint s.P)

def shapes (n : Nat) : List LocalShape := [[(none, 0)], [(none, 0), (some n, 1), (some n, 2)],
  [(none, 0), (some n, 1), (some (n + 1), 2), (some (n + 1), 3), (some n, 4)]]

def cands (s : S3) : List Op :=
  let P := List.range (s.P.length + 1)
  let A := List.range (s.A.length + 1)
  let R := regionsOf s
  let lv := leavesOf s
  let n := s.P.length
  (A.flatMap fun a => R.flatMap fun r => [Op.derive a r .observe, .derive a r .modify]) ++
  (A.flatMap fun a => (R.map fun r => Op.split a [r]) ++
     (lv.flatMap fun l => lv.filterMap fun l' => if l < l' then some (Op.split a [[l], [l']]) else none)) ++
  (A.map Op.release) ++
  (P.flatMap fun p => P.map fun q => Op.transfer p q) ++
  (P.flatMap fun q => A.map fun x => Op.depend q x) ++
  ([] :: A.map (fun a => [a])).flatMap (fun ps => (([] : LocalShape) :: shapes n).map fun ls => Op.enter ps ls) ++
  [Op.exit] ++
  (A.flatMap fun a => R.flatMap fun r => [Op.read a r, .write a r, .writeShared a r]) ++
  (P.map Op.pin) ++ ((List.range (s.pins.length + 1)).map Op.unpin) ++ (P.map Op.endUse) ++
  (P.flatMap fun p => [Op.free p 0, Op.free p 1]) ++
  (P.flatMap fun pr => P.flatMap fun ow => (shapes n).take 2 |>.map fun ls => Op.alloc pr ow ls) ++
  (A.flatMap fun a => P.map fun p => Op.store a p)

/-! ## Driver -/

structure Stats where
  checked : Nat := 0
  oks : Array Nat := Array.replicate 16 0
  fails : Nat := 0
  verdictMismatch : List String := []
  stateMismatch : List String := []
  states : Nat := 0

def lcg (x : Nat) : Nat := (x * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2147483648

/-- Check every candidate at `(sA, sB)`; return the stats and the list of ok ops (world A) with
their successors in both worlds. -/
def checkAt (R : Ren) (d : KD) (sA sB : S3) (st : Stats) (trace : List Op) :
    Stats × List (Op × S3 × S3) := Id.run do
  let d' := R.kd d
  let mut st := { st with states := st.states + 1 }
  let mut nexts : List (Op × S3 × S3) := []
  for o in cands sA do
    let (vA, tA) := step d sA o
    let (vB, tB) := step d' sB (R.op o)
    st := { st with checked := st.checked + 1 }
    if vA != vB then
      st := { st with verdictMismatch :=
        s!"{repr trace.reverse} then {repr o}: A={repr vA} B={repr vB}" :: st.verdictMismatch }
    else if vA == .ok then
      st := { st with oks := st.oks.modify o.tag (· + 1) }
      if !(eqv (R.rho tA) tB) then
        st := { st with stateMismatch := s!"{repr trace.reverse} then {repr o}" :: st.stateMismatch }
      nexts := (o, tA, tB) :: nexts
    else if vA == .fail then
      st := { st with fails := st.fails + 1 }
  return (st, nexts)

/-- Random walk: at each visited state, all candidates are checked; the next op is drawn among
the ok ones, first choosing a kind uniformly. -/
def walk (R : Ren) (d : KD) : Nat → Nat → S3 → S3 → List Op → Stats → Stats
  | 0, _, _, _, _, st => st
  | k + 1, seed, sA, sB, trace, st =>
    let (st, nexts) := checkAt R d sA sB st trace
    if nexts.isEmpty then st else
    let tags := (nexts.map (·.1.tag)).eraseDups
    let seed1 := lcg seed
    let tg := tags[seed1 % tags.length]!
    let sub := nexts.filter (·.1.tag == tg)
    let seed2 := lcg seed1
    let (o, tA, tB) := sub[seed2 % sub.length]!
    walk R d k seed2 tA tB (o :: trace) st

def report (st : Stats) : String :=
  s!"states={st.states} checked={st.checked} fails={st.fails} " ++
  s!"oks={(List.zip tagName st.oks.toList).filter (·.2 > 0)} " ++
  s!"verdictMismatch={st.verdictMismatch.length} stateMismatch={st.stateMismatch.length}" ++
  (if st.verdictMismatch.isEmpty then "" else s!"\n  first verdict mismatch: {st.verdictMismatch.getLast!}") ++
  (if st.stateMismatch.isEmpty then "" else s!"\n  first state mismatch: {st.stateMismatch.getLast!}")

end RH

  | transfer (src dst : Nat)
  | depend (q x : Nat)
  | enter (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
  | exit
  | read (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
  | write (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
  | writeShared (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
  | pin (p : Nat)
  | unpin (o : Nat)
  | endUse (p : Nat)
  | free (p auth : Nat)

  | .enter .. => 5 | .exit => 6 | .read .. => 7 | .write .. => 8 | .writeShared .. => 9
  | .pin .. => 10 | .unpin .. => 11 | .endUse .. => 12 | .free .. => 13 | .alloc .. => 14

  | .split src rs => g (SplitPre d.toK s src rs) (splitEff s src rs) s
  | .release a => g (ReleasePre s a) (releaseEff s a) s
  | .transfer a b => g (TransferPre d.toK s a b) (transferEff s a b) s
  | .depend q x => g (DependPre s q x) (dependEff s q x) s
  | .enter ps ls => g (EnterPre s ps ls) (enterEff s ps ls) s
  | .exit => g (ExitPre d.toK s) (exitEff s) s
  | .read a ls => g (Read3Pre s a ls) s s
  | .write a ls => g (Write3Pre s a ls) (write3Eff s ls) s
  | .writeShared a ls => g (WriteSharedPre d.toK s a ls) (write3Eff s ls) s

  | .unpin o => g (UnpinPre d.toK s o) (unpinEff s o) s

def Ren.holder (R : Ren) : Holder → Holder

  | .place p => .place (R.pi p)

def Ren.place (R : Ren) (pl : Place) : Place :=
  { pl with parent := pl.parent.map R.pi, owner := R.holder pl.owner }

def Ren.auth (R : Ren) (y : Authority) : Authority :=
  { y with origin := y.origin.map R.alpha, footprint := y.footprint.map R.pi,

def dPl : Place := ⟨none, .frame 0, 0⟩

/-- `ρ`: the exact state map. -/
def Ren.rho (R : Ren) (s : S3) : S3 :=
  { F := s.F, nF := s.nF

  | .transfer a b => .transfer (R.pi a) (R.pi b)
  | .depend q x => .depend (R.pi q) (R.alpha x)
  | .enter ps ls => .enter (ps.map R.alpha) ls
  | .exit => .exit
  | .read a ls => .read (R.alpha a) (ls.map R.pi)
  | .write a ls => .write (R.alpha a) (ls.map R.pi)
  | .writeShared a ls => .writeShared (R.alpha a) (ls.map R.pi)

  | .unpin o => .unpin o

  s.pins.length == t.pins.length && (List.zip s.pins t.pins).all (fun (x, y) => eqPin x y) &&
  (List.range b).all fun l => s.I l == t.I l && srt (s.D l) == srt (t.D l) && s.dead l == t.dead l

/-- Literal equality (lists compared positionally). -/
def eqLit (s t : S3) : Bool :=
  let b := max s.P.length t.P.length + 6
  s.F == t.F && s.nF == t.nF && s.P == t.P && s.A == t.A && s.pins == t.pins &&

def leavesOf (s : S3) : List Nat := (List.range s.P.length).filter fun l => decide (isLeaf s.P l)

def regionsOf (s : S3) : List (List Nat) :=
  (leavesOf s).map (fun l => [l]) ++ ((List.range s.P.length).filter fun q => decide (¬ isLeaf s.P q)).map (footprint s.P)

def shapes (n : Nat) : List LocalShape := [[(none, 0)], [(none, 0), (some n, 1), (some n, 2)],
  [(none, 0), (some n, 1), (some (n + 1), 2), (some (n + 1), 3), (some n, 4)]]

def cands (s : S3) : List Op :=
  let P := List.range (s.P.length + 1)
  let A := List.range (s.A.length + 1)
  let R := regionsOf s
  let lv := leavesOf s
  let n := s.P.length

  (A.flatMap fun a => (R.map fun r => Op.split a [r]) ++
     (lv.flatMap fun l => lv.filterMap fun l' => if l < l' then some (Op.split a [[l], [l']]) else none)) ++
  (A.map Op.release) ++
  (P.flatMap fun p => P.map fun q => Op.transfer p q) ++
  (P.flatMap fun q => A.map fun x => Op.depend q x) ++
  ([] :: A.map (fun a => [a])).flatMap (fun ps => (([] : LocalShape) :: shapes n).map fun ls => Op.enter ps ls) ++
  [Op.exit] ++
  (A.flatMap fun a => R.flatMap fun r => [Op.read a r, .write a r, .writeShared a r]) ++
  (P.map Op.pin) ++ ((List.range (s.pins.length + 1)).map Op.unpin) ++ (P.map Op.endUse) ++
  (P.flatMap fun p => [Op.free p 0, Op.free p 1]) ++
  (P.flatMap fun pr => P.flatMap fun ow => (shapes n).take 2 |>.map fun ls => Op.alloc pr ow ls) ++
  (A.flatMap fun a => P.map fun p => Op.store a p)

structure Stats where

  oks : Array Nat := Array.replicate 16 0
  fails : Nat := 0
  verdictMismatch : List String := []
  stateMismatch : List String := []

def checkAt (R : Ren) (d : KD) (sA sB : S3) (st : Stats) (trace : List Op) :
    Stats × List (Op × S3 × S3) := Id.run do
  let d' := R.kd d
  let mut st := { st with states := st.states + 1 }

    let (vB, tB) := step d' sB (R.op o)

    if vA != vB then
      st := { st with verdictMismatch :=
        s!"{repr trace.reverse} then {repr o}: A={repr vA} B={repr vB}" :: st.verdictMismatch }
    else if vA == .ok then
      st := { st with oks := st.oks.modify o.tag (· + 1) }
      if !(eqv (R.rho tA) tB) then
        st := { st with stateMismatch := s!"{repr trace.reverse} then {repr o}" :: st.stateMismatch }

def walk (R : Ren) (d : KD) : Nat → Nat → S3 → S3 → List Op → Stats → Stats
  | 0, _, _, _, _, st => st

    let tg := tags[seed1 % tags.length]!
    let sub := nexts.filter (·.1.tag == tg)
    let seed2 := lcg seed1
    let (o, tA, tB) := sub[seed2 % sub.length]!
    walk R d k seed2 tA tB (o :: trace) st

  s!"states={st.states} checked={st.checked} fails={st.fails} " ++
  s!"oks={(List.zip tagName st.oks.toList).filter (·.2 > 0)} " ++
  s!"verdictMismatch={st.verdictMismatch.length} stateMismatch={st.stateMismatch.length}" ++
  (if st.verdictMismatch.isEmpty then "" else s!"\n  first verdict mismatch: {st.verdictMismatch.getLast!}") ++
  (if st.stateMismatch.isEmpty then "" else s!"\n  first state mismatch: {st.stateMismatch.getLast!}")
